definition: The root STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE means exactly: (A) the Catholic Church is the teaching authority founded by God (`IsGod`), and (B) the twelve articles of the Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed hold. It does not yet include the full list of defined dogmas.
note: Owner decision (#156, #159): phase 1 of the root. (A) is read from Dei Filius ch. 3 and (B) from the pinned Greek Creed CREED-C381. Phase 2, the defined dogmas, is candidate CATHOLICISM-ROOT-PHASE-2-DOGMAS.
